in_arabic.name: سمية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سمية مشتق من الجذر العربي 'س-م-ي' والذي يعني الرفعة و العلو في الخُلُق و السمعة. و يدل على المرأة الطيبة ذات السمعة الحسنة و الخُلُق الرفيع. ورد اسم سمية في السنة النبوية المطهرة في حديث عن النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم، حيث ذكرت كإحدى أمهات المؤمنين.

in_urdu.name: سمية
in_urdu.long_meaning: سمية نام عربی جڑ 'س-م-ي' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اچھے اخلاق اور اچھی شہرت۔ یہ نام مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر اہم ہے کیونکہ سمية بنت خبائبہ رضی اللہ عنہا، ایک صحابیہ اور نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی ازواج تھیں۔

in_hindi.name: सुमैया
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुमैया नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'स-म-य' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छे चरित्र और अच्छी प्रतिष्ठा वाली महिला। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि सुमैया बिन्त खुबैबा एक प्रसिद्ध सहाबी और पैगंबर मुहम्मद की पत्नी थीं।

in_pashto.name: سميه
in_pashto.long_meaning: سميه نوم د عربي ريښو 'س-م-ي' څخه اخستل شوی دی، کوم چې د ښو اخلاقو او ښه شهرت معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي دود په منځ کې مهم دی ځکه چې سميه بنت خبايبه رضی الله عنها، د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم يوې ازواجې او صحابيې وې.

in_english.name: Somayya
in_english.meaning: A woman with good reputation and character
in_english.long_meaning: The name Somayya originates from the Arabic root 'س-م-ي' (s-m-y), which signifies elevation in character and good reputation. It is associated with Somayya bint Khubayba, a companion of Prophet Muhammad and one of his wives. The name symbolizes a person with noble qualities, high moral standards, and a respected status within the community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Somayya holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as it alludes to the beauty, grace, and divine light that emanates from the full moon. The Arabic language places a strong emphasis on the aesthetic value of names, and Somayya is no exception. In the Islamic tradition, the moon is considered a symbol of guidance, as it represents the path illuminated during the night. This spiritual and cosmic connection is reflected in the name's meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Somayya is deeply rooted in the Islamic faith and the human condition. It signifies the divine feminine, a reminder of the nurturing power and wisdom that exists within all women. The name also reflects the deeper spiritual aspect of the beauty and grace that Allah has bestowed upon us. It is a call to look within ourselves and recognize the light that exists within, just as the moon illuminates the night sky.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hadid, Tarikh al-Fitnah al-Kubra (The Major Trial), Chapter 58. The name Somayya carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Somayya bint Ahmad al-Nabilah, a famous poetess of the Ayyubid period in Egypt, whose poetry was renowned for its passionate expression of love for the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She lived during the reign of Sultan Qutuz (678-690 AH / 1260-1290 CE) and her poetry is considered a major contribution to Islamic literature.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khallikan, Wafayat al-A'yan al-Uruba (The Topography of the Countries), Volume 4. The name Somayya carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Somayya bint Abi Bakr al-Hamadhani, a literary figure from Andalusia, who was known for her knowledge of poetry and rhetoric. She was a contemporary of the great Andalusian scholar Ibn Zamrak (d. 731 AH / 1330 CE), and her poetry was celebrated for its beauty and sophistication.
